events.label: Sweep best of 6
events.summary: Sweep best of 6: 3.7 ± 0.5 vs 2.6 ± 1.0 for current practice (visits/week by residents who can't make current hours). SW Sweep best of 6 wins on the target metric: 3.7 ± 0.5 visits/week vs 2.6 ± 1.0 for current practice, while using the same staff as current practice (86 h/wk). It also leads the held-out cases, with the highest values in A (5.625), B (6.375), and C (5.375).
events.assumptions: This result depends on synthetic resident schedules, arrival patterns, and word-of-mouth rates from the model defaults; no known local constraints beyond the posted library hours were provided.
events.pilot: Run a 6-8 week pilot of Saturday 13:00-21:00, keeping all other hours unchanged. Measure visits/week from residents who cannot make current hours, total visits, and staff hours to confirm the gain holds in practice without increasing staffing.
